note: Final component inventory for T01-T16 (consolidated November 16, 2026). Source of the walkthrough's component pages and of docs/requirements.md section 3.

groups.name: Global — partial designs on every page

components.name: SiteHeader
components.what: Six mega-menu groups, phone sheet, language switch, Find a job. Menu spotlight link per group (Investors: Latest results & call replay, permanent).

components.name: SiteFooter
components.what: Six columns, phone accordions, utility row, Motion control, cookie preferences.

components.name: RolesDrawer
components.what: Work / where / trade / company filters, results, role view, empty state.

components.name: ResultsBar
components.what: Earnings window: shows above the header on every page for 14 days after a results release; label, one line, Results release and Call replay links; dismissed for the session.

components.name: AlertBanner
components.what: Site-wide notice: severity, schedule, dismissible, site targeting.

components.name: HomepagePopup
components.what: Scheduled modal, frequency cap, Esc and × close, focus return.

components.name: ConsentBanner
components.what: The consent tool's banner and the preferences link.

components.name: Hero
components.what: Homepage: silent film loop or still. Carousel variant (CC-12) only if Dycom opts in.

components.name: InteriorHero
components.what: Breadcrumb, H1, one sentence. Variants: photo · plain · article · with search bar (jobs, site, resources) · with listing block. Holds the PageIndex.

components.name: PageIndex
components.what: In-page navigation: jump row under the hero (numbered or unnumbered — Investors drops the numerals), or sticky 'On this page' list (with print for legal).

components.name: RichTextSection
components.what: Numbered section: heading, lede, rich text, tick list. Legal variant: numbered clauses migrated as-is.

components.name: MediaText
components.what: 50/50 photo or video beside text; left or right.

components.name: FeatureColumns
components.what: 2–4 columns with the signal mark, a brand pictogram or a photo; light or Civic. Serves the shared promo (Connection with Intention), pillars, capabilities, segments, values, Headway®/Rightway™, why Dycom.

components.name: ProcessSteps
components.what: Numbered steps, horizontal or stacked.

components.name: Lifecycle
components.what: Five-stage process route with fixed-height panels; tabs on desktop, accordion on phones. Compact route variant for landings.

components.name: Statement
components.what: One sentence set large with the signal mark; quote variant with attribution; call-replay block (one line + two actions).

components.name: MetricBand
components.what: Facts over a photo (Company Facts, one source), results metrics under a head with the quarter as a green sub-line, figure strip.

components.name: Accordion
components.what: Text, links and buttons inside; FAQ schema option (Investor FAQs).

components.name: Video
components.what: Brand film band (plays in place, muted) — on the homepage and the Investors page, inline video, tagged video library with filters.

components.name: InPageSlider
components.what: Image, video or text slides with title, description and link.

components.name: Notice
components.what: Short notice with icon: recruitment fraud (shared item), map unavailable, consent blocked.

components.name: Pathways
components.what: Four intent tiles on Civic.

components.name: TileGrid
components.what: Photo tiles, 3–4 up, optionally grouped: child pages (reads the nav group), related content, strength cards with buttons, services.

components.name: LinkColumns
components.what: Titled link groups: investor resources, governance, popular pages, Resource Center.

components.name: CoverCards
components.what: Report cards with cover image, label, title, action.

components.name: PeopleGrid
components.what: Executive / board tabs, person cards, bio dialog.

components.name: EventTimeline
components.what: Square-node timeline with Upcoming / Past tabs, split by event date at render; empty Upcoming state points to email alerts. History timeline (ABT0002) extends it.

components.name: SearchFilterBar
components.what: One search-and-filter bar: query (role + location for jobs), filter selects or year tabs, removable chips, live count, sort. Teaser variant for landings.

components.name: ResultList
components.what: Rows with item templates: news item, search result with snippet, company row. Author on/off.
components.source: IR feed, CMS or search index

components.name: JobList
components.what: Job result cards: company logo, location, type, travel, posted, trade tag, pay slot when the feed has pay. Compact 'similar roles' variant.

components.name: DocumentList
components.what: Title, file type, size, date, language tag; aside variant.

components.name: DataTable
components.what: Responsive table; stacks into labelled blocks on phones (financial statements, board committees, analyst coverage).

components.name: EmptyState
components.what: Zero results, closed role, page not found: says what happened, then ways forward (similar items, nearby companies, talent network).

components.name: ArticleBody
components.what: Dateline, body, figure strip slot, aside (documents, contact, share); Article schema.

components.name: CompanyMap
components.what: Atlas + directory + company card; the card leads to the company's own website ↗ and careers ↗. Modes: homepage chapter · full directory with filters · filtered to one service · pre-filtered to one company (for operating-company sites, MAP0009). No map below 768px.

components.name: CompanyDirectoryGrid
components.what: A–Z index, logo rows; the map's accessible list and fallback.

components.name: TradeFinder
components.what: 'Where do I fit': trades in plain language with open-role counts.

components.name: RelatedCareers
components.what: Trades for a service, live count, filtered drawer.

components.name: JobDetail
components.what: Facts block, sticky apply hand-off ↗, description sections, trade question, company card, fraud notice.

components.name: InquiryForm
components.what: One forms engine: intent selector, conditional fields, validation, success, routing by type/company/state. Variants: contact, subcontractor, talent network, document request, email alerts. Placement left/right/top/bottom (C25).

components.name: ContactOptions
components.what: Other ways to reach us: headquarters, Investor Relations, suppliers, directory.

components.name: ClosingBand
components.what: One next step: photo split, photo band or plain Civic; one primary and one secondary action.

components.name: SplitSection
components.what: Layout container with two placeholders (main + aside, or two columns).

components.name: Testimonials
components.what: Text and video testimonials, embeddable and on a standalone page.

components.name: ImageGallery
components.what: Gallery with lightbox.

components.name: SocialFeed
components.what: Third-party social feed.

components.name: BusinessSegments
components.what: Communications / Building Systems — a FeatureColumns or tabs variant once the taxonomy is set.

sharedParts.name: Link
sharedParts.notes: One underline style; → site pages, ↗ leaving the site

sharedParts.name: SignalMark
sharedParts.notes: The one permitted curve; never an arrow

sharedParts.name: Icon
sharedParts.notes: UI stroke icons + the six brand pictograms

sharedParts.name: SectionHead
sharedParts.notes: H2 + note; optional green index numeral or green sub-line

sharedParts.name: Field
sharedParts.notes: Text, select, textarea, checkbox, square toggle; error text

sharedParts.name: Tabs
sharedParts.notes: Square, green underline (one style, replaces three)

sharedParts.name: Disclosure
sharedParts.notes: Accordion item, footer and phone menu

sharedParts.name: Modal
sharedParts.notes: Dialog and drawer; focus trap and return

sharedParts.name: Share
sharedParts.notes: Copy link, email, print — nothing leaves the site

retired.name: WhoWeAre
retired.becomes: Homepage composite → decomposes into RichTextSection + FeatureColumns + MetricBand.

retired.name: PageNotice
retired.becomes: Temporary holding page; removed as pages are built.

notes.invTitle: Component inventory — the final kit for T01–T16
notes.invMerge:
CONSOLIDATION DECISIONS

Where templates solved the same problem separately, one component with variants:

• 5 search bars (jobs, resources, site, companies, documents) → SearchFilterBar
• 3 empty states + job recovery + map failure → EmptyState (+ Notice)
• Strength cards, child-page tiles, related content, service tiles → TileGrid
• Shared promo, pillars, capabilities, segments, values, Headway®/Rightway™, why Dycom → FeatureColumns
• Jump row + sticky 'On this page' + legal index → PageIndex
• Facts band + results metrics + figure strip → MetricBand
• Brand statement + quote → Statement; brand film + inline video + video library → Video
• News list + search results + company and service rows → ResultList
• Photo split + photo band + plain closing → ClosingBand
• Legal clauses → RichTextSection (numbered variant)
• Homepage form, contact, subcontractor, talent network, document request, email alerts → InquiryForm
• Article header and job-search header → InteriorHero variants
• Company profile pages removed (Nov 16, 2026): the directory card and A–Z rows go to each company's website ↗; the map's pre-filtered mode stays for operating-company sites (MAP0009)
notes.invRules:
RULES FOR THE KIT

• A new page is built from this list. A genuinely new need becomes a variant of an existing rendering before it becomes a new one.
• Every rendering reads only its datasource (or a feed through a provider) — Sitecore-ready, as the live site already is.
• Shared content has ONE item: Company Facts, Connection with Intention, the recruitment-fraud notice, navigation, Trade and Company items.
• One style per shared UI part: the four template stylesheets (tpl-a…d) fold into the brand stylesheet when built.
notes.invNext:
STILL TO DESIGN

Required by Dycom's lists but not on any template yet: AlertBanner (NAV0008), HomepagePopup (NAV0009), Testimonials (CC-6, C10), ImageGallery (CC-9), SocialFeed (CC-16), BusinessSegments (ABT0006, waits on the Building Systems taxonomy). ConsentBanner comes from the consent vendor (CC-4).

Optional: HeroCarousel (CC-12) only if Dycom opts in; HistoryTimeline (ABT0002) extends EventTimeline; a countdown counter (CC-10 example) extends MetricBand.
